children: Apple (AAPL): The company is expected to unveil a foldable phone. It's the first big product launch event for new CEO John Ternus. Shares were unchanged premarket.
Fortum (FI:FORTUM): Shares in the Nordic energy company bounced after it signed a deal with Google to power data centers in Finland.
Inditex (ES:ITX): Shares in the Zara owner dipped after its latest results showed a 9% year-on-year increase in sales.
Chewy (CHWY): The pet-supplies retailer is due to post earnings. Shares were unchanged premarket.
Burberry (UK:BRBY): Shares in the U.K. luxury brand dipped after HSBC downgraded its rating on its shares.

Amazon (AMZN): Investigators said two systems that could have slowed an Amazon Air flight that crashed in Miami over the weekend weren't deployed before the plane careened off a runway and crashed into nearby vehicles. Shares were little changed premarket.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
